title: Kamishiro Rui — Operation: Meet Santa!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Christmas Day - Early morning
Rui's Room

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Mhm...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: *Yawn*

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Looks like I fell asleep doing my final check of the script...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Huh? A blanket...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I don't remember using one.
Mom or Dad must've come to check up on me last night.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I also don't remember this red and green box being here. It certainly looks Christmas-themed...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I didn't notice at all.
But I suppose I should expect nothing less from Santa Claus. He always brings his presents on time.
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, we're all here!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We just need to wait for the car to get here, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup♪ Hehe. I'm so excited about our Christmas show.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Me too. Let's do our best today to give the guests at the ski resort an unforgettable Christmas present.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa, Nene & Emu
rows.Line:
Yes!
Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Speaking of presents, I received a wonderful one from Santa Claus earlier this morning!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It was nothing short of all three volumes of the documentary on my favorite star, Seiichi Amami!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: All three volumes? That sounds like quite a lot of content.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, because it covers everything from the practice up through the final showing of this musical where he played the lead.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, that's pretty cool.
It'd be great to hear what you thought after you've had a chance to watch it all.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course! In fact, we can even watch it together!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: If we're all gonna hang out, we should also play the game I got for Christmas♪ It's called “The Flight of the Papollo!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, I think I've heard of that.
It's the one where you work together to build a space shuttle and run missions, right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A space shuttle?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You become the executives of an aerospace research organization called KASA and work to develop a space shuttle!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: In his letter, Santa even said, “I recommend this game since it's a simplified example of how to run an organization”...♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. It was kind of him to explain why he chose this present for you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Santa? That sounds more like...
Well, as long as you're happy...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, Nene!
Did Santa stop by your house?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, yeah. He did.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: In my case, I got the air purifier I said I've been wanting for a while.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, an air purifier!
That sounds like an excellent tool for taking good care of your throat.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's why I asked them to buy... I mean, asked him to get me it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, why are you giggling...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, nothing.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Speaking of which, Rui, what did you get for Christmas...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, I was given a volume of the “Full Throttle” sci-fi series. This one asks what life would be like had our ancestors been avian in nature.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
That series again...?
I guess it is one of your favorites.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I'm not familiar...
What are you two talking about?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: For each volume, they invite world-renowned experts from a variety of fields who are connected to a subject. The discussions they have and experiments they run are detailed in each of these books.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As the name suggests, they end up doing very involved research each time, regardless of how silly the topic may seem.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see...
And the theme of the book you received was...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “What If Humans Evolved From Avian Animals?”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Avian animals? Like birds?
Or do butterflies and stuff also count?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, birds is correct.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Actually, the theme for this volume came from a discussion surrounding one of my favorite animals, the platypus.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Despite being mammals, they lay eggs, which begged the question. Would it have been possible for humans to also develop such traits?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This is expanded into discussions not only between biologists, but including experts and scholars from many different fields. I simply can't wait to read it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe! You've got such a big smile on your face right now, Rui♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I plan on reading to my heart's content once we've finished putting on our Christmas show today.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Just as the presents we received have made us smile, we need to make sure our show sends the audience home smiling!

rows.Speaker: Nene, Rui & Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!
